install.userOwnedExclusion: Only managed pipeline skill tree and commands/pipeline.md are removed on uninstall. Unrelated user commands and files under the OpenCode config dir are preserved. OPENCODE_CONFIG (single file path) is never used as a base.
install.postInstall: Invoke with /pipeline (native command routes to the launcher). Skill path: <OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.config/opencode>/skills/pipeline. Restart OpenCode if commands do not appear live.

invocation.discoveryProbe: which opencode; skill marker under OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.config/opencode

early_run_handoff.how: Parse durable run handoff JSON from launcher stdout for run_id and events path.

reattach.how: Re-arm event follow after cancelled wait; cancelled wait is not terminal.

wait_cancel.how: Cancelled wait is non-terminal; re-follow events until terminal.

material_progress_notify.how: Prefer material-filtered events.jsonl observation; host-native notify is limited.
material_progress_notify.fallback: stdout material lines via events.jsonl + material-filter.mjs (portable baseline)

terminal_cleanup.how: Stop follows for this run_id on terminal.
